items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well you won't tell anybody it's Alvin.

ctx.x: My first name was, I don't like to call it, I don't like that name. I don't like to call myself that name.
Well you won't tell anybody it's Alvin.
My name, I'll tell it to you, my name is Adolph Paul Barbera, Adolph. Adolph Paul Barbera. And you were? I speak about my nickname, how I got the nickname.
